columns.thing: where it is on the screen and what it looks like
columns.screen: the words on the screen that name it (a label, a button, a tooltip), quoted; null when no label names it
columns.his_word: the word the user says for it, from his own messages, with the date he said it; null when he has none yet
columns.code_today: the words the code says for it now; each has to be in the code, or the row is stale
columns.code_word: the one word the code is to say for it; null while unruled
columns.status: ruled: his word, given where `ruled` says | his_word: a word he has used, not yet put to him as the code's | agreed: screen, user and code already say one word | unruled: no word of his yet, the row waits for him | kept: a name from outside this app, or a thing he has no word for, so the code keeps its own
columns.retired: code words for it that are gone and stay gone; `keep` lists the tokens that may still carry the letters (another thing's name)

things.thing: this app: one window, the two prompts at the top and the sections scrolling under them
the upper text box at the top of the window, holding the text the choices below add up to
the lower text box at the top of the window
the button with the two overlapping sheets beside a prompt's title
the same button at the top of a section
the button beside a prompt that reads auto or manual, the one it will switch to
a titled frame in the scrolling part of the window
the on/off control with Off on one side and On on the other
a box that is ticked or not, in a row of them
a round button in a row of them, one of which can be chosen
a bold title inside a section with its row of choices under it
one checkbox or round button in such a row, with its word beside it
the indented choices that open under a choice once it is picked
a switch that opens a row of round buttons, whose choice also ticks the same word everywhere else in the window
the slider at the right of a section or of a bold title, with an arrow beside it that puts it back to 1
the private file that lists every section and choice; never on screen
Python's word for trimming spaces off text; never on screen
what Qt calls the rules for how the window looks; never on screen
